title: Mixed Berry Tart
description: A delicious and sweet dessert featuring a mix of berries atop a flaky crust. Perfect for spring and summer gatherings.

ingredients.name: Cold Unsalted Butter
ingredients.notes: Cut into small pieces for the crust

instructions: 2. In a large bowl, combine flour and cold butter. Use a pastry blender or your fingers to work the butter into the flour until the mixture resembles coarse crumbs.
3. Gradually add ice water, stirring with a fork until the dough comes together in a ball.
4. Turn the dough out onto a lightly floured surface and knead a few times until smooth.
5. Wrap the dough in plastic wrap and refrigerate for at least 30 minutes.
6. On a lightly floured surface, roll out the dough to a thickness of about 1/8 inch.
7. Transfer the dough to a 9-inch tart pan with a removable bottom.
8. Trim the edges and press the dough into the corners of the pan.
9. In a separate bowl, whisk together the sugar, egg, and vanilla extract. Stir in the mixed berries.
10. Pour the berry mixture into the tart shell and spread evenly.
11. Bake for 40-45 minutes, or until the crust is golden brown and the filling is bubbly.
12. Allow the tart to cool on a wire rack for at least 30 minutes before serving.
